body:
WHAT
The engine's Usage type has four disjoint token classes: fresh input, output, cache read, cache write. OpenAI-compatible APIs report `prompt_tokens` as the whole prompt and `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` as a subset of it, so the provider sets inputTokens = prompt_tokens − cached_tokens and cacheReadTokens = cached_tokens. Anthropic already reports input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens disjointly, so they map straight through.

WHY
Passing prompt_tokens through unchanged would count every cached token twice: the context meter would be inflated and cached tokens would be billed at the full input rate on top of the cache rate.

WHERE
engine/providers/src/openai-compat.ts — OpenAICompatProvider.stream() handleChunk `if (chunk.usage)` block (promptTokens, cachedTokens, `inputTokens: Math.max(0, promptTokens - cachedTokens)`, `cacheReadTokens: cachedTokens`, cacheWriteTokens 0) and the final `message_end` yield. engine/providers/src/anthropic.ts — AnthropicProvider.stream() `case 'message_start'` mapping (input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens) and `case 'message_delta'` updating usage.outputTokens. Consumed via inputTokensOf() in engine/protocol/src/tokens.ts.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Feeding the OpenAI-compatible stream parser an SSE chunk with usage {prompt_tokens:1000, completion_tokens:50, prompt_tokens_details:{cached_tokens:800}} yields message_end.usage {inputTokens:200, outputTokens:50, cacheReadTokens:800, cacheWriteTokens:0}, and inputTokensOf(usage) equals 1000.
2. A chunk with prompt_tokens:100 and no prompt_tokens_details yields inputTokens 100 and cacheReadTokens 0.
3. A malformed chunk where cached_tokens exceeds prompt_tokens yields inputTokens 0, never negative.
4. Feeding the Anthropic stream a message_start with usage {input_tokens:120, output_tokens:0, cache_read_input_tokens:900, cache_creation_input_tokens:30} yields a message_start event with usage {inputTokens:120, cacheReadTokens:900, cacheWriteTokens:30} unchanged (no subtraction), and inputTokensOf equals 1050.
5. For Anthropic, a later message_delta with usage.output_tokens 77 makes message_end.usage.outputTokens 77 while the three input classes are unchanged.
